name: vizRT TCP Engine Trio
notes: Complete list: 1 action (send, index.js) and no feedbacks (the module registers no feedbacks and defines no variables or presets).

TCP client (TCPHelper) to a Viz Engine or Viz Trio: config "Target Machine" (default "127.0.0.1"), "Target Port" (number, default 6100) and "Connect with" (engine or trio, default engine). The connection mode changes the framing: for "engine" each command is sent as "vizsend " + command + NUL (\0); for "trio" the command is sent as is followed by CRLF. The command text is split at every ";" and each part is trimmed and sent as its own message, so a literal semicolon cannot be sent. The bytes are encoded as latin1.
The "Command" option declares useVariables: { local: true } (an object, not a boolean); the catalog records useVariables: true. The callback resolves variables with context.parseVariablesInString.
The repository ships "vizRT External Commands.txt" as a command reference; the module does not validate command text. Received data is ignored.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.11.3: options do not support expressions.
